guide.summary: Chinese never moves words to make a question. Keep statement order and mark the question exactly once: add 吗, or double the verb (去不去), or offer a choice with 还是, or put a question word in the slot where the answer will go. One sentence, one question marker; that single idea removes most errors.

subs.label: 吗 vs A-not-A (去不去, 有没有)
subs.focus: Choose 吗 or A-not-A, or build the A-not-A form. Errors: both together (你去不去吗), 有不有 for 有没有, doubling the main verb instead of the modal (你想去不去), A-not-A after 很 (你很忙不忙). After 也 / 都 teach 吗, but 也 / 都 + A-not-A is said colloquially: never judge-wrong. Include 喜不喜欢, 可不可以 and 是不是 before a predicate.

subs.label: 还是 choice questions
subs.focus: The learner must pick 还是 for an either/or question and 或者 for 'or' in a statement, and must leave 吗 off a 还是 question. Classic mistakes: 你喝茶或者咖啡? and 你喝茶还是咖啡吗? Items may also test placing 还是 between the two parallel parts.

subs.label: Question words stay in place
subs.focus: Pick the right question word (谁, 什么, 哪 + measure, 哪儿, 什么时候) and put it in the answer's slot, not at the front, with no 吗. Errors: 什么你想吃?, 你去哪儿吗?, 什么时候 after the verb, 哪 without a measure word (哪书), 什么 where 哪 + measure is needed to choose among known items.

subs.label: 几 vs 多少
subs.focus: The learner must choose 几 or 多少. 几 expects a small number and must be followed by a measure word; 多少 is for any amount and can go straight before the noun. Classic mistakes: 几钱, 几学生 (no measure word), and 几 for clearly large numbers. Include the fixed uses: 几点, 几号, 星期几, 几岁, 多少钱.

subs.label: 怎么 vs 怎么样 vs 为什么
subs.focus: Choose 怎么 (how to, before a verb), 怎么样 (what it is like / how about it, as predicate) or 为什么 (why). Errors: 这个菜怎么?, 怎么样去 for method, 'how is…' with 怎么. Include 怎么 as surprised 'how come' before 不 / 没 / 还; the English cue must rule out 为什么 there.

subs.label: 多 + adjective (多大, 多长, 多远)
subs.focus: The learner must build 'how + adjective' with 多 and the right adjective: 多大 for age or size, 多长时间 or 多久 for duration, 多远 for distance, 多高, 多重. Classic mistakes: 怎么 + adjective (怎么远), 多少 + adjective (多少长), 多老 for age, and 很 left in the question. Items may also test the optional 有 before 多.

subs.label: Tag questions and 呢
subs.focus: Tags: 好吗 / 好不好 / 行吗 seek agreement to a suggestion; 对吗 / 对不对 / 是不是 / 是吗 check a fact; match tag to purpose. 呢: fits question-word, A-not-A and 还是 questions and a bare noun (你呢?), never with 吗 or on a plain statement. Errors: 你去哪儿吗?, 你是学生呢?, 好吗 to check a fact.

subs.label: Question words as 'any / every / nothing'
subs.focus: Use question word + 都 / 也 for 'everything, anyone, anywhere, nothing, nobody', with the question word before 都 / 也 even when it is the object. Errors: object left after the verb (我不想吃什么都), 都 / 也 dropped, reading it as a question. Include 没(有)什么 + noun and 也 / 都 + 不 / 没.

subs.label: Rhetorical 不是…吗
subs.focus: Recognise and build 不是 … 吗 as 'isn't it the case that…?', said when facts seem to contradict what the speaker believed. 不是 follows the subject, 吗 ends the sentence, and the middle keeps its own 不 or 了. Errors: dropping 吗, 不是 at the end, reading it as a real negative.

rules.rule: For a yes/no question, say the statement and add 吗. Nothing else changes.

examples.py: nǐ shì xué sheng ma
examples.en: Are you a student?

examples.py: nǐ míng tiān yǒu kòng ma
examples.en: Are you free tomorrow?

examples.py: nǐ men yě qù ma
examples.en: Are you going too?

rules.note: After a degree word like 很, only 吗 is possible. After 也 or 都, 吗 is the standard choice too (你们也去吗？); 也 / 都 + A-not-A (你们都去不去？) is heard in casual speech but is not the form to produce.

rules.rule: Or double the verb or adjective with 不 in between, and leave 吗 off. 有 doubles as 有没有. A two-syllable word usually doubles only its first syllable.

examples.py: nǐ míng tiān qù bù qù
examples.en: Are you going tomorrow or not?

examples.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu shí jiān
examples.en: Do you have time?

examples.py: nǐ xǐ bù xǐ huan hē chá
examples.en: Do you like drinking tea?

examples.py: zhè ge cài là bù là
examples.en: Is this dish spicy?

rules.note: The full form 喜欢不喜欢 is also correct, just less common. For a finished action ask with 没有: 你吃饭了没有? or 你吃没吃饭?

rules.rule: When there is a modal verb or 是, that is the word you double, not the verb after it.

examples.py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng qù běi jīng
examples.en: Do you want to go to Beijing?

examples.py: nǐ huì bù huì kāi chē
examples.en: Can you drive?

examples.py: tā shì bù shì nǐ gē ge
examples.en: Is he your older brother?

examples.py: nǐ shì bù shì bù shū fu
examples.en: Are you feeling unwell?

rules.note: 是不是 can be put before any predicate to check a guess, which is the easy way to ask A-not-A about a sentence that already contains 不, 也 or 很.

rules.rule: Put 还是 between the two options to ask 'A or B?'. No 吗. 或者 is the 'or' of statements, not of questions.
rules.pattern: Subject + Option A + 还是 + Option B

examples.py: nǐ hē chá hái shi hē kā fēi
examples.en: Will you have tea or coffee?

examples.zh: 我们今天去还是明天去？
examples.py: wǒ men jīn tiān qù hái shi míng tiān qù
examples.en: Shall we go today or tomorrow?

examples.zh: 周末我常常看电影或者去爬山。
examples.py: zhōu mò wǒ cháng cháng kàn diàn yǐng huò zhě qù pá shān
examples.en: At weekends I often watch a film or go hiking.

rules.note: The second verb can be dropped when it is the same (你喝茶还是咖啡?). 还是 is also used when the choice is inside a statement of not knowing: 我不知道他今天来还是明天来。

rules.rule: Write the answer sentence, then replace the unknown part with the question word. The word order does not change and there is no 吗.

examples.py: nǐ zài zhǎo shén me
examples.en: What are you looking for?

examples.py: nǐ shén me shí hou huí guó
examples.en: When are you going back to your country?

examples.py: shéi jiāo nǐ men hàn yǔ
examples.en: Who teaches you Chinese?

examples.py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ běn shū
examples.en: Which book do you want to buy?

rules.note: 什么时候 sits where a time word sits: before the verb. 哪 needs a measure word (哪个, 哪本, 哪天). 哪儿 and 哪里 mean the same. 吗 after a question word is possible only when the word means 'something / anywhere' (你想吃点儿什么吗? 'Would you like something to eat?'), which is a different sentence.

rules.rule: 几 asks for a small number (roughly under ten) and always takes a measure word. 多少 asks for any amount and can stand directly before the noun.
rules.pattern: 几 + measure + Noun / 多少 + Noun

examples.py: nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén
examples.en: How many people are there in your family?

examples.py: nǐ men xué xiào yǒu duō shao xué sheng
examples.en: How many students does your school have?

examples.py: xiàn zài jǐ diǎn
examples.en: What time is it now?

examples.py: zhè jiàn yī fu duō shao qián
examples.en: How much is this piece of clothing?

rules.note: Fixed uses: 几点, 几号, 几月, 星期几, 几岁 (for a child), 多少钱, and 多少 for phone and room numbers. When the number could be small or large, 多少 is the safe choice; with a small expected number both are often heard (几个人 / 多少人).

rules.rule: 怎么 + verb asks the way to do something. 怎么样 is the predicate: what something is like, or 'how about it?'. 为什么 asks the reason.
rules.pattern: 怎么 + Verb / Topic + 怎么样 / 为什么 + Predicate

examples.py: zhè ge zì zěn me xiě
examples.en: How do you write this character?

examples.py: nà jiā fàn guǎn zěn me yàng
examples.en: What is that restaurant like?

examples.py: nǐ wèi shén me bù gào su wǒ
examples.en: Why didn't you tell me?

examples.py: nǐ zěn me hái méi shuì
examples.en: How come you're still not asleep?

rules.note: 怎么 before 不, 没, 还, 这么 or 了 means 'how come' and carries surprise; 为什么 is the neutral 'why' and fits in the same place. 你怎么了? means 'What's wrong with you?'.

rules.rule: For 'how old, how long, how far, how tall', put 多 before the adjective. An optional 有 may come before 多. No 很, no 怎么.

examples.py: nǐ ér zi duō dà le
examples.en: How old is your son?

examples.py: cóng zhè r dào jī chǎng yǒu duō yuǎn
examples.en: How far is it from here to the airport?

examples.py: nǐ xué le duō cháng shí jiān hàn yǔ
examples.en: How long have you studied Chinese?

examples.py: nǐ dì di duō gāo
examples.en: How tall is your younger brother?

rules.note: Use the 'big' adjective of the pair: 多大, 多长, 多远, 多高, 多重, never 多小 or 多短 for a neutral question. 多久 means the same as 多长时间. To an older person say 您多大年纪? rather than 你多大?

rules.rule: To turn a statement into a tag question, finish the sentence and add a short question. 好吗 / 好不好 / 行吗 ask someone to agree to a suggestion; 对吗 / 对不对 / 是不是 / 是吗 check a fact.
rules.pattern: Statement + 好吗 / 对不对 / 是不是

examples.py: wǒ men yī qǐ qù hǎo ma
examples.en: Let's go together, shall we?

examples.py: nǐ shì shàng hǎi rén duì bù duì
examples.en: You're from Shanghai, right?

examples.py: nǐ míng tiān bù shàng bān shì bù shì
examples.en: You're not working tomorrow, are you?

rules.note: The tag does not change with the sentence: a negative statement still takes 对不对 or 是不是, unlike English 'are you / aren't you'.

rules.rule: 呢 softens a question that already has a question word, an A-not-A form or 还是, and after a bare noun it asks 'and what about…?'. It never joins 吗 and cannot turn a plain statement into a yes/no question.
rules.pattern: Question-word question + 呢 / Noun + 呢

examples.py: nǐ zài kàn shén me ne
examples.en: What are you looking at?

examples.py: wǒ hěn hǎo nǐ ne
examples.en: I'm fine, and you?

examples.py: tā zěn me hái méi lái ne
examples.en: Why hasn't he come yet?

examples.py: wǒ de shǒu jī ne
examples.en: Where's my phone?

rules.note: 呢 on these questions is optional; it adds a thoughtful or puzzled tone. With no earlier context, Noun + 呢 asks where the thing is.

rules.rule: Question word + 都 / 也 means 'every / any'; with 不 or 没 after it, 'no / none'. The question word must stand before 都 / 也, so an object moves in front of the verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + Question word + 都 / 也 + (不 / 没) + Verb

examples.py: zhè jiàn shì shéi dōu zhī dào
examples.en: Everyone knows about this.

examples.py: wǒ jīn tiān shén me dōu bù xiǎng chī
examples.en: I don't feel like eating anything today.

examples.py: zhōu mò wǒ nǎ r yě méi qù
examples.en: I didn't go anywhere at the weekend.

examples.py: wǒ méi shén me wèn tí
examples.en: I don't really have any questions.

rules.note: In positive sentences use 都 (谁都知道); 也 is mostly for negatives, where 都 is equally fine. 没(有)什么 + noun stays after the verb and means 'not much, nothing in particular'.

rules.rule: 不是 … 吗 does not ask and does not negate: it reminds the listener of something the speaker believes is true, often with surprise. Put 不是 after the subject and 吗 at the end.

examples.py: nǐ bù shì shuō jīn tiān lái ma
examples.en: Didn't you say you were coming today?

examples.py: tā bù shì yǐ jīng huí guó le ma
examples.en: Hasn't he already gone back to his country?

examples.zh: 你不是不喜欢吃辣的吗？
examples.py: nǐ bù shì bù xǐ huan chī là de ma
examples.en: I thought you didn't like spicy food?

rules.note: The part between 不是 and 吗 is what the speaker thinks is true, so it keeps its own 不, 没 or 了.

right.py: nǐ míng tiān qù bù qù

contrasts.why: 去不去 is already the question. Standard Chinese does not add 吗 to an A-not-A form.

right.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu shí jiān

contrasts.why: 有 is negated only with 没, so its A-not-A form is 有没有.
A-not-A is built on the bare adjective, so 很 cannot stand in front of it. With 很 ask 你很忙吗？ After 也 / 都 the standard question also uses 吗 (你们也去吗？).

right.en: What do you want to eat?

contrasts.why: The question word stays where the answer goes: after 吃, as its object. It does not move to the front as in English.
哪儿 already makes it a question. To soften it use 呢, not 吗.

right.py: nǐ xiǎng hē chá hái shi kā fēi
right.en: Would you like tea or coffee?

contrasts.why: 'Or' that asks the listener to choose is 还是. 或者 only lists alternatives in a statement.

right.en: How much money do you have?

contrasts.why: 几 must be followed by a measure word and expects a small number. An open amount with no measure word takes 多少.

right.py: zhè ge cài zěn me yàng

contrasts.why: 'How is it?' asks what something is like, which is 怎么样. 怎么 needs a verb after it and asks the way of doing.

right.py: nǐ nǚ ér duō dà le

contrasts.why: Age is asked with 多大. 老 means elderly, so 多老 does not ask someone's age.

right.py: wǒ shén me dōu bù xiǎng chī
right.en: I don't want to eat anything.

contrasts.why: The question word must come before 都, so the object 什么 moves in front of the verb.

cheat: One question marker per sentence: 吗, or A-not-A, or 还是, or a question word. Don't stack two.
Question word goes where the answer goes. Don't move it to the front.
也 / 都 / 很 in the sentence? Ask with 吗. With a modal, double the modal: 想不想去.
Asking someone to choose: 还是. 'Or' in a statement: 或者.
几 + measure word for small numbers; 多少 for anything else and for 钱.
怎么 + verb = how to; 怎么样 = how is it; 多 + adjective = how big / long / far.
什么 / 谁 / 哪儿 before 都 or 也 is not a question: it means every / any / none.

items.py: nǐ míng tiān qù bù qù
items.en: Are you going tomorrow?
items.why: 去不去 is already the question, so 吗 must be left out. Adding 吗 gives the ungrammatical 去不去吗.

items.zh: 你们老师会不会说英语？
items.py: nǐ men lǎo shī huì bù huì shuō yīng yǔ
items.en: Can your teacher speak English?
items.why: With a modal verb the modal is doubled: 会不会 + verb. 会吗 before the verb and a half-doubled 会不 are not possible here.

items.py: nǐ men gōng sī yǒu méi yǒu shí táng
items.en: Does your company have a canteen?
items.why: 有 is only negated by 没, so its A-not-A form is 有没有. 有不有 does not exist, and 吗 cannot sit between the two 有.

items.py: nǐ yě qù tú shū guǎn ma
items.en: Are you going to the library too?
items.why: After 也 only 吗 can make the question. A-not-A cannot follow 也, 都 or 很, so 去不去 fails.

items.zh: 你想不想报名参加考试？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng bào míng cān jiā kǎo shì
items.en: Do you want to sign up for the exam?
items.why: The modal 想 is the word doubled: 想不想 + verb. 想没想 would ask about a past event, and 吗 cannot go in the middle.

items.zh: 你是不是在办公室加班？
items.py: nǐ shì bù shì zài bàn gōng shì jiā bān
items.en: Are you working overtime in the office?
items.why: 是不是 before a predicate checks a guess. 是 is negated with 不, never 没, and 吗 cannot be inserted in the middle.

items.q: 老师，我可___可以问一个问题？
items.zh: 老师，我可不可以问一个问题？
items.py: lǎo shī wǒ kě bù kě yǐ wèn yī gè wèn tí
items.en: Teacher, may I ask a question?
items.why: 可以 is a modal, so the first syllable doubles: 可不可以. The negator in A-not-A with a modal is 不, not 没.

items.q: 你想坐飞机___坐火车去上海？
items.zh: 你想坐飞机还是坐火车去上海？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng zuò fēi jī hái shi zuò huǒ chē qù shàng hǎi
items.en: Do you want to go to Shanghai by plane or by train?
items.why: A question that asks the listener to pick one needs 还是. 或者 is the 'or' of statements, and 和 only means 'and'.

items.q: 我不知道明天考试___后天考试。
items.zh: 我不知道明天考试还是后天考试。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào míng tiān kǎo shì hái shi hòu tiān kǎo shì
items.en: I don't know whether the exam is tomorrow or the day after.
items.why: Inside a clause of not knowing, the two uncertain options are joined by 还是. 或者 would present them as a list of alternatives that are both fine.

items.q: 你可以发邮件___打电话给我，都行。
items.zh: 你可以发邮件或者打电话给我，都行。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ fā yóu jiàn huò zhě dǎ diàn huà gěi wǒ dōu xíng
items.en: You can email or phone me, either is fine.
items.why: This is a statement offering alternatives, so it takes 或者. 还是 is reserved for questions and statements of not knowing which one.

items.q: 你的同事是北京人___上海人？
items.zh: 你的同事是北京人还是上海人？
items.py: nǐ de tóng shì shì běi jīng rén hái shi shàng hǎi rén
items.en: Is your colleague from Beijing or Shanghai?
items.why: Asking which of two it is calls for 还是, and the question is then complete without 吗.

items.py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ běn cí diǎn
items.en: Which dictionary do you want to buy?
items.why: Choosing among known items uses 哪 + measure word. 什么本 is not a phrase, and 谁 asks about people.

items.py: wǒ men shén me shí hou kāi huì
items.en: When are we having the meeting?
items.why: 'When' is the fixed phrase 什么时候, placed before the verb. 哪时候 and 几时候 are not used.

items.py: nǐ de zuò yè fàng zài nǎ r
items.en: Where did you put your homework?
items.why: A place is asked with 哪儿, kept in the slot after 在. Bare 哪 needs a measure word and cannot stand for a place.

items.py: shéi jiāo nǐ men shù xué
items.en: Who teaches you maths?
items.why: A person subject is replaced by 谁 in the same position. 什么 asks about things, not people.

items.py: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ mén kè
items.en: Which course do you like best?
items.why: With a measure word (门) the word for 'which' is 哪. 什么门课 is not said, and 谁 is for people.

items.py: nǐ zài gēn shéi shuō huà
items.en: Who are you talking to?
items.why: The person after 跟 is replaced by 谁 in place. 什么 and 哪儿 do not ask about a person.

items.py: qǐng wèn xǐ shǒu jiān zài nǎ r
items.en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?
items.why: Asking where something is uses 哪儿 after 在. 哪个 needs a noun to follow it and 什么 does not ask for a place.

items.py: jīn tiān xīng qī jǐ
items.en: What day of the week is it today?
items.why: The answer is one of the seven days, so the fixed question is 星期几. 星期多少 and 星期什么 are not used.

items.py: zhè běn shū duō shao qián
items.en: How much is this book?
items.why: Price is always 多少钱. 几钱 is a classic error since 几 needs a measure word and expects a small count.

items.py: nǐ men dà xué yǒu duō shao xué sheng
items.en: How many students does your university have?
items.why: A university has a large, open number, and 多少 can stand right before the noun. 几 would need a measure word and expects a small number.

items.py: nǐ de shēng rì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào
items.en: What date is your birthday?
items.why: Dates are asked with 几月几号, both parts small numbers. 多少号 is not the normal way to ask a date, and 什么号 is wrong.

items.q: 你们这么大的公司，一共有___员工？
items.zh: 你们这么大的公司，一共有多少员工？
items.py: nǐ men zhè me dà de gōng sī yī gòng yǒu duō shao yuán gōng
items.en: With a company this big, how many employees do you have in all?
items.why: The number is expected to be large and 员工 follows directly with no measure word, which only 多少 allows. 几 would need a measure word.

items.py: xiàn zài jǐ diǎn le gāi shàng kè le
items.en: What time is it now? It's time for class.
items.why: Clock time is always 几点. 多少点 and 什么点 are not used.

items.py: zhè ge hàn zì zěn me xiě
items.en: How do you write this character?
items.why: 'How to do' something is 怎么 + verb. 怎么样 is a predicate, and 为什么 would ask why you write it.

items.zh: 你觉得这次考试怎么样？
items.py: nǐ jué de zhè cì kǎo shì zěn me yàng
items.en: What did you think of this exam?
items.why: Asking for an opinion of something uses 怎么样 as the predicate. 怎么 needs a verb after it.

items.py: nǐ wèi shén me méi lái shàng kè
items.en: Why didn't you come to class?
items.why: The reason is asked with 为什么 before 没. 怎么样 asks what something is like, and 什么 does not mean 'why' here.

items.py: qǐng wèn qù huǒ chē zhàn zěn me zǒu
items.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
items.why: The way of doing something is 怎么 + verb. 怎么样 cannot precede the verb, and 为什么 asks for a reason.

items.zh: 都十二点了，你怎么还没睡？
items.py: dōu shí èr diǎn le nǐ zěn me hái méi shuì
items.en: It's already twelve, how come you still haven't gone to bed?
items.why: 怎么 before 还没 is the surprised 'how come'. 怎么样 and 什么 cannot stand before an adverb in this way.

items.q: 你们学校离地铁站有___远？
items.zh: 你们学校离地铁站有多远？
items.py: nǐ men xué xiào lí dì tiě zhàn yǒu duō yuǎn
items.en: How far is your school from the subway station?
items.why: 'How far' is 多 + 远, with an optional 有 before it. 很远 is a statement and 怎么远 is not grammatical.

items.py: nǐ mèi mei jīn nián duō dà le
items.en: How old is your younger sister this year?
items.why: Age is asked with 多大. 很大 is a statement of size, and 什么大 does not ask for age.

items.zh: 你要在北京住多长时间？
items.py: nǐ yào zài běi jīng zhù duō cháng shí jiān
items.en: How long are you going to stay in Beijing?
items.why: Duration is 多长时间, with 多 before the adjective 长. 多少长 and 几长 are not possible.

items.py: zhè zuò bàn gōng lóu yǒu duō gāo
items.en: How tall is this office building?
items.why: Height is asked with 多 + 高, with 有 before it. 多少高 and 怎么高 do not work with an adjective.

items.py: nǐ de xíng li yǒu duō zhòng
items.en: How heavy is your luggage?
items.why: With 有 and a measuring adjective, 多重 asks how heavy. 有很重 would be the answer, not the question.

items.py: wǒ men yī qǐ fù xí hǎo ma
items.en: Let's review together, shall we?
items.why: A suggestion needs agreement, so the tag is 好吗. 是吗 and 对不对 check a fact and do not fit a proposal.

items.py: nǐ shì xīn lái de tóng shì duì ma
items.en: You're the new colleague, right?
items.why: A tag that checks a fact is 对吗. 好吗 and 行吗 ask someone to accept a suggestion.

items.py: wǒ hěn hǎo nǐ ne
items.en: I'm fine, and you?
items.why: A bare pronoun asking 'and what about...?' takes 呢. 吗 would need a full statement, and 吧 would be a guess.

items.py: nǐ zài xiě shén me ne
items.en: What are you writing?
items.why: 呢 may soften a question that already has 什么. 吗 never joins a question word, and 了 does not fit the ongoing action.

items.zh: 这个问题谁都知道答案。
items.py: zhè ge wèn tí shéi dōu zhī dào dá àn
items.en: Everyone knows the answer to this question.
items.why: In 'everyone', the question word comes right before 都: 谁都. 都谁 is reversed and 谁吗 makes it a question.

items.q: 周末我___没去，一直在宿舍复习。
items.zh: 周末我哪儿也没去，一直在宿舍复习。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ nǎ r yě méi qù yī zhí zài sù shè fù xí
items.en: I didn't go anywhere at the weekend, I studied in my dorm the whole time.
items.why: 去 is followed by a place, so the indefinite is 哪儿也 + 没. 什么也 and 谁也 would mean 'nothing' and 'nobody'.

items.zh: 我今天太累了，什么都不想做。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān tài lèi le shén me dōu bù xiǎng zuò
items.en: I'm so tired today that I don't want to do anything.
items.why: 'Anything' in a negative sentence is 什么都 + 不, before the verb. 都什么 reverses the order.

items.zh: 老师问了半天，谁也没回答。
items.py: lǎo shī wèn le bàn tiān shéi yě méi huí dá
items.en: The teacher asked for a long time but nobody answered.
items.why: The one who answers is a person, so 谁也 + 没 means 'nobody'. 什么也 and 哪儿也 stand for things and places.

items.zh: 你不是说今天交报告吗？
items.py: nǐ bù shì shuō jīn tiān jiāo bào gào ma
items.en: Didn't you say we hand in the report today?
items.why: The reminder pattern is 不是 after the subject and 吗 at the end. 没 or 呢 do not give the 'but you said' meaning.

items.py: tā bù shì yǐ jīng bì yè le ma
items.en: Hasn't he already graduated?
items.why: 不是 ... 吗 is a bracket, so the sentence must close with 吗. 呢 does not close this reminder, and 的 would make it a flat statement, not a question.

items.py: wǒ men bù shì míng tiān fàng jià ma
items.en: Aren't we on holiday tomorrow?
items.why: The rhetorical frame needs both 不是 before the predicate and 吗 at the end. 没有 changes the meaning, and 呢 cannot close it.

items.py: nǐ míng tiān qù bù qù xué xiào
items.en: Are you going to school tomorrow?
items.why: The A-not-A form sits where the verb goes, after the time word; no 吗 needed. The time word may also open the sentence.

items.zh: 你想不想参加这次考试？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng cān jiā zhè cì kǎo shì
items.en: Do you want to take part in this exam?
items.why: The modal 想 is doubled, and the main verb 参加 is not.

items.py: lǎo shī shì bù shì zài bàn gōng shì
items.en: Is the teacher in the office?
items.why: 是不是 comes before the predicate 在办公室 and replaces 吗.

items.zh: 你们公司有没有周末加班的规定？
items.py: nǐ men gōng sī yǒu méi yǒu zhōu mò jiā bān de guī dìng
items.en: Does your company have a rule about working at weekends?
items.why: 有没有 is the A-not-A of 有, and it comes before the whole noun phrase 周末加班的规定.

items.zh: 我们今天开会还是明天开会？
items.py: wǒ men jīn tiān kāi huì hái shi míng tiān kāi huì
items.en: Are we having the meeting today or tomorrow?
items.why: 还是 links two parallel parts. The time word may come before or after 我们, but the two options must stay on either side of 还是.

items.zh: 你打算坐地铁去上班还是开车去上班？
items.py: nǐ dǎ suàn zuò dì tiě qù shàng bān hái shi kāi chē qù shàng bān
items.en: Do you plan to go to work by subway or by car?
items.why: 还是 sits between the two parallel plans, each of which has its own 去上班.

items.py: nǐ de shū bāo zài nǎ r
items.en: Where is your schoolbag?
items.why: 哪儿 stays in the slot after 在, where the answer would be.

items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou xià kè
items.en: When do you finish class?
items.why: 什么时候 is a time word and sits before the verb, either before or after the subject.

items.py: nǐ men bān shéi huì shuō rì yǔ
items.en: Who in your class can speak Japanese?
items.why: 谁 replaces the subject in its own place, before 会.

items.zh: 这位老师教你们哪门课？
items.py: zhè wèi lǎo shī jiāo nǐ men nǎ mén kè
items.en: Which course does this teacher teach you?
items.why: 哪门课 stays as the object after 教你们, not at the front.

items.zh: 你打算什么时候交论文？
items.py: nǐ dǎ suàn shén me shí hou jiāo lùn wén
items.en: When do you plan to hand in your thesis?
items.why: 什么时候 is a time word placed before the verb it asks about. It may sit before or after 打算, or open the sentence.

items.zh: 这个办公室有多少台电脑？
items.py: zhè ge bàn gōng shì yǒu duō shao tái diàn nǎo
items.en: How many computers does this office have?
items.why: 多少 comes before the measure word and noun, in the slot of the number.

items.py: zhè ge zì zěn me dú
items.en: How do you pronounce this character?
items.why: 怎么 goes directly before the verb to ask how it is done.

items.py: nǐ wèi shén me méi zuò zuò yè
items.en: Why didn't you do your homework?
items.why: 为什么 comes before the verb phrase and before 没. It may also open the sentence.

items.zh: 你觉得这家公司怎么样？
items.py: nǐ jué de zhè jiā gōng sī zěn me yàng
items.en: What do you think of this company?
items.why: 怎么样 closes the sentence as the predicate asking what it is like.

items.py: nǐ dì di duō dà le
items.en: How old is your younger brother?
items.why: 多大 asks age, and 了 follows to close it.

items.py: cóng gōng sī dào nǐ jiā yǒu duō yuǎn
items.en: How far is it from the company to your home?
items.why: 多远 comes last, with the optional 有 before it.

items.zh: 你在这家公司工作了多长时间？
items.py: nǐ zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le duō cháng shí jiān
items.en: How long have you worked at this company?
items.why: The duration phrase follows the verb and cannot go before it. 了 may sit after the verb (工作了多长时间) or at the end of the sentence (工作多长时间了).

items.zh: 我们下午一起去图书馆好吗？
items.py: wǒ men xià wǔ yī qǐ qù tú shū guǎn hǎo ma
items.en: Shall we go to the library together this afternoon?
items.why: The tag 好吗 closes a suggestion. The time word may come before or after the subject.

items.py: nǐ shì xīn tóng xué duì bù duì
items.en: You're the new classmate, right?
items.why: A tag checking a fact is added at the end of a complete statement.

items.py: wǒ jīn tiān shén me dōu bù xiǎng zuò
items.en: I don't feel like doing anything today.
items.why: 什么 comes before 都 and the negated verb, so the object moves ahead of the verb. The time word may come before or after the subject.

items.zh: 这个问题谁都回答不了。
items.py: zhè ge wèn tí shéi dōu huí dá bù liǎo
items.en: Nobody can answer this question.
items.why: The topic 这个问题 comes first, then 谁 before 都, and the potential complement 不了 closes it. Fronting 谁都 and leaving the object after the verb is also fine.

items.zh: 你不是说下个月要去上海出差吗？
items.py: nǐ bù shì shuō xià gè yuè yào qù shàng hǎi chū chāi ma
items.en: Didn't you say you were going to Shanghai on a business trip next month?
items.why: 不是 follows the subject, 吗 ends the sentence, and the thing the speaker remembers sits in between.

items.src_py: xiǎo wáng jīn tiān lái gōng sī
items.task: Turn it into an A-not-A question.
items.py: xiǎo wáng jīn tiān lái bù lái gōng sī
items.en: Is Xiao Wang coming to the company today?
items.why: The verb 来 becomes 来不来 and no 吗 is added. The time word may also open the sentence.

items.src_py: tā huì shuō fǎ yǔ
items.task: Turn it into an A-not-A question.
items.py: tā huì bù huì shuō fǎ yǔ
items.en: Can he speak French?
items.why: The modal 会 is doubled, not the main verb 说.

items.src: 你想学英语。你想学日语。
items.src_py: nǐ xiǎng xué yīng yǔ nǐ xiǎng xué rì yǔ
items.task: Combine into one choice question with 还是.
items.py: nǐ xiǎng xué yīng yǔ hái shi rì yǔ
items.en: Do you want to study English or Japanese?
items.why: 还是 joins the two objects, and the repeated 你想学 is dropped.

items.src_py: nǐ zài tú shū guǎn xué xí
items.task: Ask 'where' about the place.
items.py: nǐ zài nǎ r xué xí
items.en: Where do you study?
items.why: 哪儿 replaces 图书馆 in the same slot before the verb.

items.src_py: xiǎo lǐ jiāo tā men wù lǐ
items.task: Ask 'who' about the teacher.
items.py: shéi jiāo tā men wù lǐ
items.en: Who teaches them physics?
items.why: 谁 replaces 小李 as the subject, with no change in word order.

items.src_py: zhè tái dǎ yìn jī yī qiān kuài
items.task: Ask the price with 多少.
items.py: zhè tái dǎ yìn jī duō shao qián
items.en: How much is this printer?
items.why: The price is always asked with 多少钱, taking the place of the amount.

items.src_py: zhè ge jù zi zhè yàng xiě
items.task: Ask how to write it with 怎么.
items.py: zhè ge jù zi zěn me xiě
items.en: How do you write this sentence?
items.why: 怎么 replaces 这样 right before the verb to ask the way of doing it.

items.src: 他的办公室离这儿很远。
items.src_py: tā de bàn gōng shì lí zhè r hěn yuǎn
items.task: Ask about the distance with 多.
items.zh: 他的办公室离这儿多远？
items.py: tā de bàn gōng shì lí zhè r duō yuǎn
items.en: How far is his office from here?
items.why: 很远 becomes 多远, so 很 is dropped.

items.src_py: wǒ men míng tiān kāi huì
items.task: Add a tag asking for agreement.
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān kāi huì hǎo ma
items.en: Let's have the meeting tomorrow, shall we?
items.why: A proposal is tagged with 好吗 at the end.

items.py: nǐ míng tiān qù bù qù kāi huì
items.en: Are you going to the meeting tomorrow?
items.why: 去不去 already forms the question, so adding 吗 is ungrammatical.
items.s_py: nǐ míng tiān qù bù qù kāi huì ma

items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu bǐ
items.en: Do you have a pen?
items.why: 有 is only negated with 没, so the A-not-A form must be 有没有.
items.s_py: nǐ yǒu bù yǒu bǐ

items.py: nǐ xiǎng xué shén me
items.en: What do you want to study?
items.why: The question word stays in the answer's slot, after 学, and does not move to the front.
items.s_py: shén me nǐ xiǎng xué

items.py: zhè cì kǎo shì zěn me yàng
items.en: How was this exam?
items.why: Asking what something is like requires 怎么样; bare 怎么 needs a verb after it.
items.s_py: zhè cì kǎo shì zěn me

items.s: 你们公司离这儿多少远？
items.py: nǐ men gōng sī lí zhè r duō yuǎn
items.en: How far is your company from here?
items.why: 'How + adjective' is 多 + adjective. 多少 is for amounts and cannot go before 远.
items.s_py: nǐ men gōng sī lí zhè r duō shao yuǎn

items.py: nǐ qù nǎ r
items.en: Where are you going?
items.why: 哪儿 already makes this a question, so 吗 cannot be added.
items.s_py: nǐ qù nǎ r ma

items.py: nǐ yě xiǎng xué rì yǔ ma
items.en: Do you want to study Japanese too?
items.why: After 也 only 吗 can form the question, so this is correct; 你也想不想学日语 would be wrong.
items.s_py: nǐ yě xiǎng xué rì yǔ ma

items.py: nǐ shì bù shì méi dài zuò yè
items.en: Didn't you bring your homework?
items.why: 是不是 checks a guess and can sit before a predicate that already has 没. This is how to ask an A-not-A about a negative.

items.s: 我想问你一个问题，可以吗？
items.zh: 我想问你一个问题，可以吗？
items.py: wǒ xiǎng wèn nǐ yī gè wèn tí kě yǐ ma
items.en: I'd like to ask you a question, may I?
items.why: 可以吗 is a normal tag asking permission, so this is correct.

items.py: zhōu mò wǒ nǎ r yě bù xiǎng qù
items.en: I don't want to go anywhere at the weekend.
items.why: 哪儿也 + 不 is the correct way to say 'nowhere'. It is a statement, not a question.

items.py: nǐ xiǎng hē diǎn r shén me ma
items.en: Would you like something to drink?
items.why: Here 什么 means 'something', not a question word, so a yes/no question with 吗 is correct.

items.py: nǐ zěn me hái méi jiāo zuò yè
items.en: How come you haven't handed in your homework yet?
items.why: 怎么 before 还没 is the standard surprised 'how come', so this is correct.

items.s: 他不是去北京出差了吗？
items.zh: 他不是去北京出差了吗？
items.py: tā bù shì qù běi jīng chū chāi le ma
items.en: Didn't he go to Beijing on a business trip?
items.why: 不是 ... 吗 is a reminder pattern, and the middle keeps its 了.

items.py: nǐ men xué xiào dà bù dà
items.en: Is your school big?
items.why: Adjectives can form A-not-A questions directly, so this is correct.

items.s: 我不知道他明天来还是后天来。
items.zh: 我不知道他明天来还是后天来。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào tā míng tiān lái hái shi hòu tiān lái
items.en: I don't know whether he is coming tomorrow or the day after.
items.why: 还是 is also used for uncertain options inside a statement of not knowing, so this is correct.

items.s: 我们公司没什么新同事。
items.zh: 我们公司没什么新同事。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī méi shén me xīn tóng shì
items.en: Our company doesn't have many new colleagues.
items.why: 没什么 + noun is correct and stays after the verb. It is a statement, not a question.

items.py: nǐ mā ma yě zài jiā ma
items.en: Is your mom at home too?
items.why: 也 is in the sentence, so the question has to be marked with 吗 at the end. A-not-A (在不在) cannot follow 也, and 还是 needs two options to choose between.

items.py: nǐ men jiā yǒu méi yǒu xǐ yī jī
items.en: Does your family have a washing machine?
items.why: 有 is negated only by 没, so its A-not-A form is 有没有. 有不有 does not exist, and 吗 would pile a second question marker onto the sentence.

items.zh: 你想不想买这辆自行车？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng mǎi zhè liàng zì xíng chē
items.en: Do you want to buy this bike?
items.why: With a modal verb, double the modal: 想不想, then the plain verb 买 follows. 买不想 doubles in the wrong order, and 想吗 puts a 吗 in the middle of the sentence.

items.zh: 你昨天买没买那件外套？
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān mǎi méi mǎi nà jiàn wài tào
items.en: Did you buy that coat yesterday?
items.why: 昨天 puts the purchase in the past, and a past action is negated with 没, so the A-not-A form is 买没买. 买不买 asks about a habit or a decision still to be made.

items.zh: 你是不是也想买这条裙子？
items.py: nǐ shì bú shì yě xiǎng mǎi zhè tiáo qún zi
items.en: Do you want to buy this skirt too?
items.why: 是不是 can stand before a whole predicate to check a guess, so it can come before 也. 想不想 would repeat the modal in front of 想买, and 吗 can only close the sentence.

items.py: nǐ xǐ huan hóng de hái shì lán de
items.en: Do you like the red one or the blue one?
items.why: A question that offers two choices puts 还是 between them. 或者 is the plain "or" of statements, and 吗 cannot be added to a choice question.

items.q: 周末我想在家洗衣服___看电视。
items.zh: 周末我想在家洗衣服或者看电视。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng zài jiā xǐ yī fu huò zhě kàn diàn shì
items.en: At the weekend I want to wash clothes or watch TV at home.
items.why: This is a statement listing two possible plans, so "or" is 或者. 还是 is kept for questions that ask the listener to pick one.

items.zh: 你们是现金付款还是刷卡？
items.py: nǐ men shì xiàn jīn fù kuǎn hái shì shuā kǎ
items.en: Will you pay in cash or by card?
items.why: The shop assistant wants one of two answers, so 还是 goes between the options. 或者 belongs to statements, and no 吗 is needed.

items.q: 你要大号的___小号的，我去仓库给你拿。
items.zh: 你要大号的还是小号的，我去仓库给你拿。
items.py: nǐ yào dà hào de hái shì xiǎo hào de wǒ qù cāng kù gěi nǐ ná
items.en: Do you want the large size or the small size? I will fetch it from the storeroom.
items.why: Offering the customer a choice is 还是. 或者 would not ask for a decision, and 吗 or 也 cannot link two options.

items.py: shéi zài chú fáng zuò fàn
items.en: Who is cooking in the kitchen?
items.why: 谁 stands in the subject slot, exactly where the answer "Mom" would go. 哪 and 几 need a measure word, and 什么 asks about things, not people.

items.py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ jiàn chèn shān
items.en: Which shirt do you want to buy?
items.why: Choosing among shirts that are in front of you takes 哪 plus a measure word: 哪件. 什么 cannot stand directly before 件, and 谁 and 哪儿 ask about people and places.

items.zh: 你们什么时候去超市买东西？
items.py: nǐ men shén me shí hou qù chāo shì mǎi dōng xī
items.en: When are you going to the supermarket to buy things?
items.why: "When" is 什么时候, and like any time word it sits before the verb. 什么 asks "what", 哪儿 asks "where" and 几 asks "how many".

items.zh: 小王的爸爸在哪儿上班？
items.py: xiǎo wáng de bà ba zài nǎ r shàng bān
items.en: Where does Xiao Wang's dad work?
items.why: The answer would be a place after 在, so the slot holds 哪儿. 哪个 would need a noun after it (哪个公司), and 谁 and 什么 do not stand for places.

items.q: 桌子上有两个杯子，你要___个？
items.zh: 桌子上有两个杯子，你要哪个？
items.py: zhuō zi shàng yǒu liǎng gè bēi zi nǐ yào nǎ ge
items.en: There are two cups on the table. Which one do you want?
items.why: Picking one of two cups you can both see is 哪 plus a measure word. 什么个 is not possible; 什么 would go before a noun, as in 什么杯子.

items.zh: 你想给奶奶买什么礼物？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng gěi nǎi nai mǎi shén me lǐ wù
items.en: What present do you want to buy for Grandma?
items.why: An open "what kind of" question takes 什么 straight before the noun. 哪 and 几 need a measure word, so 哪礼物 and 几礼物 are not grammatical.

items.q: 你昨天在商场门口等的那位客人是___？
items.zh: 你昨天在商场门口等的那位客人是谁？
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān zài shāng chǎng mén kǒu děng de nà wèi kè ren shì shéi
items.en: Who was the customer you waited for at the mall entrance yesterday?
items.why: Asking who someone is puts 谁 where the name would go. 什么 would ask what a thing is, and 哪 and 几 need a measure word after them.

items.py: nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng
items.en: What time do you get up every day?
items.why: Clock hours are asked with the fixed form 几点. 多少点 is not used for the time, and 怎么点 and 什么点 do not mean "what time".

items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī duō shǎo qián
items.en: How much is this mobile phone?
items.why: A price is always asked with 多少钱. 几钱 fails because 几 needs a measure word and expects a small number, and 什么钱 would mean "what money".

items.py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi duō shǎo píng guǒ
items.en: How many apples do you want to buy?
items.why: With no measure word between the question word and 苹果, 多少 is the one that can stand directly before the noun. 几苹果 and 哪苹果 lack a measure word, and 什么苹果 would mean "what kind of apples".

items.zh: 妈妈的手机号码是多少？
items.py: mā ma de shǒu jī hào mǎ shì duō shǎo
items.en: What is Mom's phone number?
items.why: A phone number is a long string of digits, not a small count, so it is asked with 多少. 几 expects a small number with a measure word, so 是几 cannot ask for a number like this.

items.zh: 今天星期几？商店开门吗？
items.py: jīn tiān xīng qī jǐ shāng diàn kāi mén ma
items.en: What day of the week is it today? Is the shop open?
items.why: Days of the week are asked with the fixed phrase 星期几. 多少 is never used here, and 星期哪 and 星期什么 are not said.

items.py: zhè ge xǐ yī jī zěn me yòng
items.en: How do you use this washing machine?
items.why: Asking how to do something is 怎么 directly before the verb 用. 怎么样 asks what something is like and cannot precede a verb, and 为什么 asks for a reason.

items.q: 你觉得这家商店的衣服___？
items.zh: 你觉得这家商店的衣服怎么样？
items.py: nǐ jué de zhè jiā shāng diàn de yī fu zěn me yàng
items.en: What do you think of the clothes in this shop?
items.why: "What is it like?" ends the sentence with the predicate 怎么样. 怎么 needs a verb after it, so 衣服怎么 is unfinished, and 为什么 asks for a reason, not an opinion.

items.q: 已经十二点了，你___还不睡觉？
items.zh: 已经十二点了，你怎么还不睡觉？
items.py: yǐ jīng shí èr diǎn le nǐ zěn me hái bù shuì jiào
items.en: It is already twelve. How come you still have not gone to bed?
items.why: 怎么 before 还不 means "how come" and shows surprise that things are not as expected. 怎么样 is a predicate and cannot come before 还不, and 哪 and 几 do not fit here.

items.q: 妈妈___不让我买这个玩具？
items.zh: 妈妈为什么不让我买这个玩具？
items.py: mā ma wèi shén me bù ràng wǒ mǎi zhè ge wán jù
items.en: Why won't Mom let me buy this toy?
items.why: A plain request for a reason is 为什么, placed before 不. 怎么样 asks what something is like, and 什么 and 哪 cannot stand before 不让.

items.zh: 在这家店，你可以怎么付钱？
items.py: zài zhè jiā diàn nǐ kě yǐ zěn me fù qián
items.en: In this shop, in what ways can you pay?
items.why: "In what way" before a verb is 怎么. 怎么样 and 什么样 describe what something is like and cannot go before 付钱, and 为什么 would ask why.

items.q: 这台洗衣机的声音这么大，你___还说它很安静？
items.zh: 这台洗衣机的声音这么大，你怎么还说它很安静？
items.py: zhè tái xǐ yī jī de shēng yīn zhè me dà nǐ zěn me hái shuō tā hěn ān jìng
items.en: This washing machine is so loud. How come you still say it is quiet?
items.why: 怎么 before 还说 means "how come" and shows surprise at a contradiction. 怎么样 is a predicate, 什么 does not fit before a verb phrase here, and 哪里 would ask about a place.

items.py: nǐ dì di jīn nián duō dà le
items.en: How old is your younger brother this year?
items.why: Age is asked with 多 plus the "big" adjective: 多大. 几大, 多少大 and 怎么大 are not used to ask for an age.

items.py: cóng nǐ jiā dào chāo shì yǒu duō yuǎn
items.en: How far is it from your home to the supermarket?
items.why: "How far" is 多 plus the neutral adjective 远: 多远. 怎么 asks how to do something, 多少 asks for an amount, and 多近 is not the neutral question about distance.

items.py: nǐ men jiā de shā fā yǒu duō cháng
items.en: How long is your family's sofa?
items.why: Length is asked with 有多长: 多 goes directly before the adjective 长. 几, 多少 and 怎么 cannot be put in front of an adjective.

items.q: 你每天在商店工作___时间？
items.zh: 你每天在商店工作多长时间？
items.py: nǐ měi tiān zài shāng diàn gōng zuò duō cháng shí jiān
items.en: How long do you work in the shop every day?
items.why: Duration is asked with 多长时间. The adjective 长 follows 多 directly; 多少长, 怎么长 and 几长 are not possible.

items.q: 你们搬进这个新家___了，习惯了吗？
items.zh: 你们搬进这个新家多久了，习惯了吗？
items.py: nǐ men bān jìn zhè ge xīn jiā duō jiǔ le xí guàn le ma
items.en: How long have you been in this new home? Have you got used to it?
items.why: 多久 is the fixed "how long" for a stretch of time, the same as 多长时间. 多少久, 几久 and 怎么久 are not words.

items.zh: 我们周末一起去逛街，好吗？
items.py: wǒ men zhōu mò yì qǐ qù guàng jiē hǎo ma
items.en: Let's go shopping together at the weekend, shall we?
items.why: A suggestion that asks the listener to agree takes 好吗. 对吗 and 是吗 check whether a fact is true, and 呢 cannot follow a plain statement like this.

items.zh: 你是小李的姐姐，对不对？
items.py: nǐ shì xiǎo lǐ de jiě jie duì bú duì
items.en: You are Xiao Li's older sister, right?
items.why: Checking a fact you believe is true takes 对不对. 好不好 and 行吗 ask someone to agree to a plan, which does not fit a statement of identity.

items.py: mā ma wǒ de shū bāo ne
items.en: Mom, where is my schoolbag?
items.why: After a bare noun, 呢 asks "where is it?". 吗 would ask a yes/no question about the schoolbag itself, and 的 and 了 do not form a question.

items.q: 这些菜是你今天早上买的，___？
items.zh: 这些菜是你今天早上买的，对吗？
items.py: zhè xiē cài shì nǐ jīn tiān zǎo shàng mǎi de duì ma
items.en: You bought these vegetables this morning, right?
items.why: The speaker is checking a fact, so the tag is 对吗. 好吗 and 行吗 ask for approval of a suggestion, and a statement about the past is not a suggestion.

items.q: 我今天去超市买了菜，还给奶奶买了药，你___？
items.zh: 我今天去超市买了菜，还给奶奶买了药，你呢？
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān qù chāo shì mǎi le cài hái gěi nǎi nai mǎi le yào nǐ ne
items.en: Today I went to the supermarket for vegetables, and I also bought medicine for Grandma. What about you?
items.why: After a statement about oneself, a noun or pronoun plus 呢 asks "and what about you?". 吗 would turn it into a yes/no question about 你 alone, and 的 and 了 cannot close it.

items.q: 桌子上___也没有，连一支笔都没有。
items.zh: 桌子上什么也没有，连一支笔都没有。
items.py: zhuō zi shàng shén me yě méi yǒu lián yī zhī bǐ dōu méi yǒu
items.en: There is nothing on the table, not even a pen.
items.why: 什么 plus 也 plus 没有 means "nothing". 谁 would mean "nobody" and 哪儿 "nowhere", which do not fit objects on a table.

items.q: 这个牌子的衣服___都能买到。
items.zh: 这个牌子的衣服哪儿都能买到。
items.py: zhè ge pái zi de yī fu nǎ r dōu néng mǎi dào
items.en: You can buy this brand's clothes anywhere.
items.why: 哪儿 plus 都 means "anywhere", and it comes before 都 and the verb. 谁 would mean "anybody", which is not what is meant here.

items.q: 这件衣服___什么问题，就是有点儿贵。
items.zh: 这件衣服没有什么问题，就是有点儿贵。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu méi yǒu shén me wèn tí jiù shì yǒu diǎn r guì
items.en: There is nothing much wrong with this piece of clothing, it is just a bit expensive.
items.why: 没有什么 + noun means "not any / nothing in particular", and the noun stays after the verb. 不 cannot negate 有, and 别 is a command.

items.q: 他们家的亲戚我___也不认识，所以不想去参加婚礼。
items.zh: 他们家的亲戚我谁也不认识，所以不想去参加婚礼。
items.py: tā men jiā de qīn qī wǒ shéi yě bù rèn shi suǒ yǐ bù xiǎng qù cān jiā hūn lǐ
items.en: I do not know anyone among their relatives, so I do not want to go to the wedding.
items.why: "Nobody" is 谁 + 也 + 不 with 谁 before 也. 什么 would say "nothing", and 哪儿 and 几 do not stand for people.

items.q: 你___说今天给我买新书包吗？
items.zh: 你不是说今天给我买新书包吗？
items.py: nǐ bú shì shuō jīn tiān gěi wǒ mǎi xīn shū bāo ma
items.en: Didn't you say you would buy me a new schoolbag today?
items.why: Reminding someone of what they said takes 不是 after the subject and 吗 at the end. 不会 and 别 do not give the "didn't you say" meaning, and 是不是 clashes with 吗.

items.zh: 你姐姐不是已经结婚了吗？
items.py: nǐ jiě jie bú shì yǐ jīng jié hūn le ma
items.en: Hasn't your sister already got married?
items.why: 不是 … 吗 reminds the listener of something the speaker believes is already true. 没有 cannot be put before 已经 here, and 是不是 would clash with 吗.

items.q: 爸爸不是说这个周末带我们去商场___？
items.zh: 爸爸不是说这个周末带我们去商场吗？
items.py: bà ba bú shì shuō zhè ge zhōu mò dài wǒ men qù shāng chǎng ma
items.en: Didn't Dad say he would take us to the mall this weekend?
items.why: The pattern 不是 … 吗 must be closed by 吗; without it the sentence is just a negative statement. 的, 了 and 哪 cannot end this question.

items.zh: 你爸爸明天去不去超市？
items.py: nǐ bà ba míng tiān qù bù qù chāo shì
items.en: Is your dad going to the supermarket tomorrow?
items.why: The A-not-A form 去不去 sits where the verb goes, before the object 超市. 明天 may come before or after the subject but cannot follow the verb phrase, and no 吗 is added.

items.zh: 你妈妈会不会用微波炉？
items.py: nǐ mā ma huì bú huì yòng wēi bō lú
items.en: Can your mom use a microwave?
items.why: With a modal, the modal is doubled: 会不会 comes before the verb phrase 用微波炉. No 吗 is added, because the doubled form already asks the question.

items.zh: 你是不是也想买新沙发？
items.py: nǐ shì bú shì yě xiǎng mǎi xīn shā fā
items.en: Do you want to buy a new sofa too?
items.why: 是不是 stands before the predicate to check a guess, and 也 follows it directly before 想买. The question needs no 吗.

items.py: nǐ xiǎng hē chá hái shì hē kā fēi
items.en: Do you want to drink tea or coffee?
items.why: 还是 sits between the two parallel options and no 吗 is added. 或者 would only list options in a statement.

items.zh: 妈妈想买红色的还是蓝色的？
items.py: mā ma xiǎng mǎi hóng sè de hái shì lán sè de
items.en: Does Mom want to buy the red one or the blue one?
items.why: The two options are joined by 还是, which is itself the question marker, so nothing like 吗 closes the sentence.

items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù yín háng
items.en: When are you going to the bank?
items.why: 什么时候 behaves like any time word: it goes before the verb, either after or before the subject, and never at the end of the sentence as "when" does in English.

items.py: shéi gěi nǐ mǎi le zhè běn shū
items.en: Who bought you this book?
items.why: 谁 stays in the subject slot, where the answer "Dad" would go. The sentence keeps statement order and adds no 吗.

items.py: nǐ jiě jie zài nǎ r mǎi yī fu
items.en: Where does your older sister buy clothes?
items.why: 在哪儿 sits where 在商场 would sit, before the verb phrase. It does not move to the front of the sentence as in English.

items.py: zhè tiáo kù zi duō shǎo qián
items.en: How much are these trousers?
items.why: 多少钱 is the fixed way to ask a price and goes at the end, where the price would be. 几钱 is not possible.

items.py: nǐ yí gè yuè huā duō shǎo qián
items.en: How much money do you spend a month?
items.why: 多少钱 fills the object slot after 花. 一个月 is a time frame that may come before or after 你 but not after 花.

items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī zěn me yòng
items.en: How do you use this phone?
items.why: 怎么 comes right before the verb it asks about: 怎么用. 怎么样 would be a predicate and cannot precede 用.

items.py: nǐ jué de zhè jiā diàn zěn me yàng
items.en: What do you think of this shop?
items.why: 怎么样 is the predicate at the end, asking what the shop is like. 怎么 alone could not end the sentence.

items.zh: 你为什么不买那件外套？
items.py: nǐ wèi shén me bù mǎi nà jiàn wài tào
items.en: Why don't you buy that coat?
items.why: 为什么 comes before 不买, as a reason word sits before the verb phrase. It can precede or follow 你 but never stands at the end.

items.py: nǐ sūn zi duō dà le
items.en: How old is your grandson?
items.why: 多 plus the "big" adjective 大 asks the age, and 了 closes it. Neither 很 nor 吗 is added.

items.py: cóng nǐ jiā dào shāng chǎng yǒu duō yuǎn
items.en: How far is it from your home to the mall?
items.why: The start and goal come first, then 有多远. 有 may be dropped, but it cannot follow 多远.

items.zh: 你在这家店工作了多长时间？
items.py: nǐ zài zhè jiā diàn gōng zuò le duō cháng shí jiān
items.en: How long have you worked in this shop?
items.why: 多长时间 asks the duration and closes the verb phrase. The place phrase 在这家店 stays before the verb and may come before or after 你.

items.py: wǒ men yì qǐ qù chāo shì hǎo ma
items.en: Let's go to the supermarket together, okay?
items.why: The statement comes first and the tag 好吗 closes it, with 一起 before the verb phrase. 好吗 asks for agreement to a suggestion.

items.zh: 你是奶奶的邻居，对不对？
items.py: nǐ shì nǎi nai de lín jū duì bú duì
items.en: You are Grandma's neighbour, right?
items.why: To check a fact you believe is true, finish the statement and add 对不对. The tag always stands at the end.

items.py: wǒ jīn tiān zài jiā nǐ ne
items.en: I am at home today, and you?
items.why: 你呢 follows a statement and asks about the other person. 今天 may come before or after 我 but 在家 stays after the subject.

items.py: nǐ zài zhǎo shén me ne
items.en: What are you looking for?
items.why: 呢 can close a question that already has a question word. 什么 stays after 在找, where the answer would go.

items.zh: 这家店的价格谁都知道。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de jià gé shéi dōu zhī dào
items.en: Everybody knows this shop's prices.
items.why: 谁 before 都 means "everyone". The object 这家店的价格 is placed first as the topic, so 谁 can stand right in front of 都.

items.py: jīn tiān wǒ nǎ r yě bù xiǎng qù
items.en: I do not want to go anywhere today.
items.why: 哪儿 + 也 + a negative verb means "nowhere". The question word stands before 也, not after the verb.

items.py: tā zài shāng chǎng shén me yě méi mǎi
items.en: He did not buy anything at the mall.
items.why: 什么 + 也 + 没 means "nothing". The place phrase 在商场 stays before the verb and may come before or after 他.

items.zh: 你不是说过给我买新手机吗？
items.py: nǐ bú shì shuō guò gěi wǒ mǎi xīn shǒu jī ma
items.en: Didn't you say you would buy me a new phone?
items.why: 不是 follows the subject and 吗 closes the sentence; the middle part states what the speaker believes was promised.

items.src_py: nǐ nǎi nai xǐ huan zhè jiàn máo yī
items.task: Turn it into an A-not-A question.
items.zh: 你奶奶喜不喜欢这件毛衣？
items.py: nǐ nǎi nai xǐ bù xǐ huan zhè jiàn máo yī
items.en: Does your grandma like this sweater?
items.why: The first syllable of 喜欢 is doubled with 不: 喜不喜欢. 吗 is not added, since the A-not-A form is already the question.

items.src_py: tā xiǎng qù shāng chǎng
items.task: Ask it with 想不想 (an A-not-A question).
items.py: tā xiǎng bù xiǎng qù shāng chǎng
items.en: Does she want to go to the mall?
items.why: With a modal verb the modal is doubled: 想不想, and the verb phrase 去商场 follows unchanged.

items.src_py: nǐ xiàn jīn fù kuǎn
items.task: Ask "cash or card?" with 还是.
items.py: nǐ xiàn jīn fù kuǎn hái shì shuā kǎ
items.en: Will you pay in cash or by card?
items.why: The two options sit on either side of 还是 and the statement order is kept. 吗 and 或者 are both wrong in a choice question.

items.src_py: mā ma zài chāo shì mǎi le yú
items.task: Ask where Mom bought the fish.
items.py: mā ma zài nǎ r mǎi le yú
items.en: Where did Mom buy the fish?
items.why: 哪儿 replaces 超市 in the same slot, so 在哪儿 stays before the verb. Nothing moves and no 吗 is added.

items.src_py: zhè ge bēi zi shí wǔ kuài
items.task: Ask the price.
items.py: zhè ge bēi zi duō shǎo qián
items.en: How much is this cup?
items.why: Price is asked with 多少钱, put in the slot of the amount. 几 cannot be used because it needs a measure word.

items.src_py: wǒ ér zi wǔ suì le
items.task: Ask how old your son is.
items.py: nǐ ér zi duō dà le
items.en: How old is your son?
items.why: Age is asked with 多大, with the 了 of the statement kept. 几岁 is for a small child, while 多大 is the general form.

items.src_py: nǐ zuó tiān méi lái
items.task: Ask "how come?" with 怎么.
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān zěn me méi lái
items.en: How come you didn't come yesterday?
items.why: 怎么 stands right before 没来 and expresses surprise that it did not happen. The time word 昨天 stays before it.

items.src_py: wǒ men zhōu mò qù shāng chǎng
items.task: Add a tag asking if that is okay.
items.py: wǒ men zhōu mò qù shāng chǎng hǎo ma
items.en: Let's go to the mall at the weekend, okay?
items.why: A suggestion is turned into a request for agreement by adding 好吗 at the end. The statement itself does not change.

items.src_py: wǒ méi mǎi dōng xī
items.task: Say "I bought nothing at all" with 什么.
items.py: wǒ shén me yě méi mǎi
items.en: I did not buy anything.
items.why: 什么 replaces 东西 and moves in front of 也 and the negative verb, which gives "nothing at all". It is not a question.

items.src: 爸爸已经把钱给奶奶了。
items.src_py: bà ba yǐ jīng bǎ qián gěi nǎi nai le
items.task: Say "Hasn't Dad already...?" with 不是 ... 吗.
items.zh: 爸爸不是已经把钱给奶奶了吗？
items.py: bà ba bú shì yǐ jīng bǎ qián gěi nǎi nai le ma
items.en: Hasn't Dad already given the money to Grandma?
items.why: 不是 goes after the subject and 吗 closes the sentence. What lies between keeps its own 了, since it is what the speaker believes is true.

items.s_py: nǐ yǒu bù yǒu líng qián
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu líng qián
items.en: Do you have any small change?
items.why: 有 is negated only with 没, so its A-not-A form is 有没有. 有不有 does not exist.

items.s: 你妹妹喜不喜欢这件裙子吗？
items.s_py: nǐ mèi mei xǐ bù xǐ huan zhè jiàn qún zi ma
items.zh: 你妹妹喜不喜欢这件裙子？
items.py: nǐ mèi mei xǐ bù xǐ huan zhè jiàn qún zi
items.en: Does your younger sister like this skirt?
items.why: 喜不喜欢 already asks the question, so adding 吗 stacks two question markers. Use one or the other, never both.

items.s: 你想买红的还是蓝的吗？
items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi hóng de hái shì lán de ma
items.py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi hóng de hái shì lán de
items.en: Do you want to buy the red one or the blue one?
items.why: 还是 already makes the choice question, so 吗 is a second question marker and must go.

items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ shū
items.py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ běn shū
items.en: Which book do you want to buy?
items.why: 哪 always needs a measure word before the noun, so 哪本书 is right. 哪书 is not possible.

items.s_py: nǐ yī gòng huā le jǐ qián
items.py: nǐ yī gòng huā le duō shǎo qián
items.en: How much did you spend in total?
items.why: Money is asked with 多少钱. 几 needs a measure word and expects a small number, so 几钱 does not exist.

items.s_py: zhè jiā diàn de dōng xī zěn me
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de dōng xī zěn me yàng
items.en: What are the things in this shop like?
items.why: "What is it like?" needs 怎么样 as the predicate. 怎么 alone needs a verb after it and cannot end the sentence.

items.s: 我想知道这个手机怎么样用。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎng zhī dào zhè ge shǒu jī zěn me yàng yòng
items.zh: 我想知道这个手机怎么用。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng zhī dào zhè ge shǒu jī zěn me yòng
items.en: I want to know how to use this phone.
items.why: "How to do something" is 怎么 plus the verb. 怎么样 describes what something is like and cannot stand before 用.

items.s_py: nǐ men jiā lí xué xiào duō shǎo yuǎn
items.py: nǐ men jiā lí xué xiào duō yuǎn
items.en: How far is your home from the school?
items.why: "How far" is 多 plus 远. 多少 asks for an amount and cannot be put in front of an adjective.

items.s_py: nǐ shì wǒ de lín jū ne
items.py: nǐ shì wǒ de lín jū ma
items.en: Are you my neighbour?
items.why: 呢 cannot turn a plain statement into a yes/no question; that takes 吗. 呢 fits questions that already have a question word, and bare nouns.

items.s: 你是不是不想吃妈妈做的菜？
items.s_py: nǐ shì bú shì bù xiǎng chī mā ma zuò de cài
items.zh: 你是不是不想吃妈妈做的菜？
items.py: nǐ shì bú shì bù xiǎng chī mā ma zuò de cài
items.en: Is it that you do not want to eat the dish Mom made?
items.why: 是不是 can stand before a predicate that already contains 不, to check a guess. Adding 吗 or doubling 想 would clash with that 不.

items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng kàn diàn shì
items.py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng kàn diàn shì
items.en: Do you want to watch TV?
items.why: With a modal verb the modal is doubled: 想不想, followed by the plain verb 看. No 吗 is needed.

items.s: 我不知道妈妈今天买鱼还是买肉。
items.s_py: wǒ bù zhī dào mā ma jīn tiān mǎi yú hái shì mǎi ròu
items.zh: 我不知道妈妈今天买鱼还是买肉。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào mā ma jīn tiān mǎi yú hái shì mǎi ròu
items.en: I do not know whether Mom is buying fish or meat today.
items.why: 还是 is also used inside a statement when the speaker does not know which of two things is true. 或者 would wrongly present both as simply possible.

items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng chī diǎn r shén me ma
items.py: nǐ xiǎng chī diǎn r shén me ma
items.en: Would you like something to eat?
items.why: Here 什么 means "something", not "what", so the sentence is a yes/no question and needs 吗. It is correct even though a real "what" question never takes 吗.

items.s: 你们家一个月花多少钱？
items.s_py: nǐ men jiā yí gè yuè huā duō shǎo qián
items.zh: 你们家一个月花多少钱？
items.py: nǐ men jiā yí gè yuè huā duō shǎo qián
items.en: How much does your family spend a month?
items.why: Spending is an open amount, so 多少 is right, and it needs no measure word before 钱. 几 would expect a very small number.

items.s_py: nǐ zěn me hái méi qǐ chuáng
items.py: nǐ zěn me hái méi qǐ chuáng
items.en: How come you still have not got up?
items.why: 怎么 before 还没 means "how come" and shows surprise. It is correct even though 怎么 usually asks "how to".

items.s: 你爷爷今年多大年纪了？
items.s_py: nǐ yé ye jīn nián duō dà nián jì le
items.zh: 你爷爷今年多大年纪了？
items.py: nǐ yé ye jīn nián duō dà nián jì le
items.en: How old is your grandfather this year?
items.why: 多大年纪 is the polite way to ask an older person's age; the pattern 多 + 大 is still used, with no 很 and no 怎么.

items.s_py: nǐ míng tiān bù zài jiā shì bú shì
items.py: nǐ míng tiān bù zài jiā shì bú shì
items.en: You will not be at home tomorrow, will you?
items.why: A negative statement still takes the same tag 是不是. Chinese does not flip the tag as English does.

items.s: 周末我哪儿也不想去，只想在家休息。
items.s_py: zhōu mò wǒ nǎ r yě bù xiǎng qù zhǐ xiǎng zài jiā xiū xī
items.zh: 周末我哪儿也不想去，只想在家休息。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ nǎ r yě bù xiǎng qù zhǐ xiǎng zài jiā xiū xī
items.en: At the weekend I do not want to go anywhere, I just want to rest at home.
items.why: 哪儿 + 也 + 不 means "nowhere" and stands before the verb. It is not a question about where.

items.s_py: nǐ bú shì bù ài chī yú ma
items.py: nǐ bú shì bù ài chī yú ma
items.en: I thought you did not like fish?
items.why: 不是 … 吗 reminds the listener of what the speaker believed, and the part between keeps its own 不. The two negatives do not cancel out.

items.py: zhè ge yào kǔ bù kǔ
items.en: Is this medicine bitter?
items.why: An adjective makes its A-not-A question with 不 between the two copies. 没 negates 有 or a past event, and 吗 would add a second question marker.

items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu fā shāo
items.en: Do you have a fever?
items.why: 有 is negated only by 没, so its A-not-A form is 有没有. 有不有 does not exist, and 吗 cannot sit between the two 有.

items.py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng qù yī yuàn kàn kan
items.en: Do you want to go and get checked at the hospital?
items.why: The modal 想 is the word that doubles: 想不想 + verb. 没 would negate a past event, and 吗 inside the verb phrase is not possible.

items.py: nǐ men dōu xǐ huan dōng tiān ma
items.en: Do you all like winter?
items.why: After 都 only 吗 can mark the question; A-not-A cannot follow 都. 不喜欢 would turn the sentence into a statement.

items.py: nǐ shì bù shì duì huā fěn guò mǐn
items.en: Are you allergic to pollen?
items.why: 是不是 placed before the predicate asks about a guess. 没 does not negate 是, and 吗 cannot be squeezed between the two 是.

items.py: míng tiān huì bù huì xià xuě
items.en: Will it snow tomorrow?
items.why: The modal 会 is doubled with 不: 会不会 + verb. 没会 does not exist, and 吗 in the middle would not form a question.

items.py: nǐ hē rè shuǐ hái shi liáng shuǐ
items.en: Do you want hot water or cold water?
items.why: An either/or question that makes the listener choose uses 还是. 或者 is the 'or' of statements, and 和 means 'and'.

items.q: 不舒服的时候，你可以吃点药___睡一觉。
items.zh: 不舒服的时候，你可以吃点药或者睡一觉。
items.py: bù shū fu de shí hou nǐ kě yǐ chī diǎn yào huò zhě shuì yī jiào
items.en: When you feel unwell, you can take some medicine or get some sleep.
items.why: This is a statement listing two options, so it takes 或者. 还是 is reserved for questions that ask the listener to choose, and 而且 would add rather than offer alternatives.

items.q: 夏天你想去海边___去山里？
items.zh: 夏天你想去海边还是去山里？
items.py: xià tiān nǐ xiǎng qù hǎi biān hái shi qù shān lǐ
items.en: In summer, do you want to go to the seaside or to the mountains?
items.why: The sentence asks which one the listener prefers, so 还是 joins the two options. 或者 cannot be used in a question like this.

items.q: 我不知道明天会下雨___下雪。
items.zh: 我不知道明天会下雨还是下雪。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào míng tiān huì xià yǔ hái shi xià xuě
items.en: I don't know whether it will rain or snow tomorrow.
items.why: An unknown choice inside 'I don't know…' still uses 还是. 或者 would say 'rain or snow' as a list of possibilities, and 吗 cannot be added.

items.py: nǐ nǎ r téng
items.en: Where does it hurt?
items.why: The question word sits where the answer would go: 头疼 / 肚子疼 are places, so 哪儿. 什么 would ask 'what hurts' in a different structure.

items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou kě yǐ chū yuàn
items.en: When can you leave the hospital?
items.why: 'When' is 什么时候, which sits before the verb like any time word. 哪 needs a measure word and 谁 asks who.

items.q: 你要哪___药，红的还是白的？
items.zh: 你要哪个药，红的还是白的？
items.py: nǐ yào nǎ ge yào hóng de hái shi bái de
items.en: Which medicine do you want, the red one or the white one?
items.why: Choosing one item from known options takes 哪 + a measure word, and 个 is the general one for 药 here. 位 is only used for people and 本 for books, so neither fits medicine.

items.py: zhè bǎ sǎn shì shéi de
items.en: Whose umbrella is this?
items.why: Owner is asked with 谁的. 什么的 and a bare 哪的 do not ask who owns something.

items.q: 你觉得这个城市___个季节最舒服？
items.zh: 你觉得这个城市哪个季节最舒服？
items.py: nǐ jué de zhè ge chéng shì nǎ ge jì jié zuì shū fu
items.en: Which season do you think is the most comfortable in this city?
items.why: With the measure word 个 already present, the choosing word is 哪: 哪个季节. 什么 does not take a measure word in this way.

items.zh: 今天医院来了多少病人？
items.py: jīn tiān yī yuàn lái le duō shao bìng rén
items.en: How many patients came to the hospital today?
items.why: With no measure word before the noun, only 多少 works. 几 must be followed by a measure word, and 多 alone does not mean 'how many'.

items.py: zhè píng shuǐ duō shao qián
items.en: How much is this bottle of water?
items.why: The price question is the fixed phrase 多少钱. 几钱 is not used, and 多钱 is not a question phrase.

items.py: nǐ nǚ ér jīn nián jǐ suì le
items.en: How old is your daughter this year?
items.why: A child's age is asked with 几岁. 几年 would ask how many years, and 个 is not the measure word for age.

items.q: 春天一般从___月开始变暖？
items.zh: 春天一般从几月开始变暖？
items.py: chūn tiān yī bān cóng jǐ yuè kāi shǐ biàn nuǎn
items.en: Which month does spring usually start to warm up from?
items.why: Months are asked with the fixed form 几月. 多少月 is never said, and 哪月 lacks the measure word that 哪 needs.

items.py: zhè zhǒng yào zěn me chī
items.en: How do you take this medicine?
items.why: 'How to do it' is 怎么 right before the verb. 怎么样 is a predicate on its own, and 为什么 would ask for a reason.

items.q: 你___还没吃药？你中午说过要吃的。
items.zh: 你怎么还没吃药？你中午说过要吃的。
items.py: nǐ zěn me hái méi chī yào nǐ zhōng wǔ shuō guo yào chī de
items.en: How come you still haven't taken your medicine? You said you would at noon.
items.why: 怎么 before 还没 means 'how come' and carries surprise. 怎么样 cannot sit before a verb phrase like this.

items.py: nǐ zěn me le liǎn sè bù tài hǎo
items.en: What's wrong with you? You don't look well.
items.why: 你怎么了 is the fixed way to ask what is wrong. 你怎么样了 would ask how you are now, which does not fit the cue.

items.py: qǐng wèn qù yī yuàn zěn me zǒu
items.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the hospital?
items.why: Asking the way to do something puts 怎么 before the verb 走. 怎么样 would ask what it is like, and 为什么 would ask why.

items.zh: 你怎么知道我今天要出院？
items.py: nǐ zěn me zhī dào wǒ jīn tiān yào chū yuàn
items.en: How did you know I'm leaving hospital today?
items.why: The cue asks 'how did you know', the way or source, so 怎么 + verb. 为什么 would ask why you know, and 怎么样 cannot precede a verb.

items.q: 秋天去北京旅游，你觉得___？
items.zh: 秋天去北京旅游，你觉得怎么样？
items.py: qiū tiān qù běi jīng lǚ yóu nǐ jué de zěn me yàng
items.en: How about travelling to Beijing in autumn?
items.why: 你觉得 + 怎么样 asks for an opinion at the end of a sentence. 怎么 needs a verb after it, and 为什么 asks for a reason.

items.py: nǐ jīn nián duō dà le
items.en: How old are you this year?
items.why: Age is asked with 多 + 大. 几大 is not a phrase, and 很 makes a statement, not a question.

items.py: yī yuàn lí zhè r yǒu duō yuǎn
items.en: How far is the hospital from here?
items.why: 'How far' is 多远, with optional 有 before it. 很远 is a statement, and 怎么远 is not a question about distance.

items.py: nǐ fā shāo duō cháng shí jiān le
items.en: How long have you had a fever?
items.why: Duration is asked with 多长时间. 几 and 多少 cannot be put in front of 长时间.

items.q: 这条河冬天结冰以后，冰有___厚？
items.zh: 这条河冬天结冰以后，冰有多厚？
items.py: zhè tiáo hé dōng tiān jié bīng yǐ hòu bīng yǒu duō hòu
items.en: How thick is the ice once the river freezes in winter?
items.why: 'How thick' is 多厚, with 有 allowed before it. 怎么厚 and 多少厚 do not ask about a measurement.

items.q: 你这样一天要睡___久才够？
items.zh: 你这样一天要睡多久才够？
items.py: nǐ zhè yàng yī tiān yào shuì duō jiǔ cái gòu
items.en: How long do you have to sleep a day to get enough?
items.why: 'How long' in time is 多久 (= 多长时间). 怎么久 and 几久 are not used.

items.py: wǒ men míng tiān qù pá shān hǎo ma
items.en: We're going hiking tomorrow, shall we?
items.why: A suggestion that asks for agreement takes 好吗. 对吗 and 是吗 check whether a fact is true, which does not fit 'shall we'.

items.py: nǐ shì yī shēng duì bù duì
items.en: You're a doctor, right?
items.why: The speaker is checking a fact, so the tag is 对不对. 好吗 and 行吗 ask someone to agree to a proposal.

items.py: nǐ zuó wǎn méi shuì hǎo shì bù shì
items.en: You didn't sleep well last night, did you?
items.why: Checking a negative fact takes 是不是, with no change for the 没. 好不好 and 行吗 ask for agreement to a plan.

items.py: nǐ zài kàn shén me ne
items.en: What are you looking at?
items.why: A question-word question may end in 呢 to sound curious. 吗 cannot be added to a question word question, and 了 is not a question particle.

items.zh: 你怎么还不去看医生呢？
items.py: nǐ zěn me hái bù qù kàn yī shēng ne
items.en: How come you still haven't gone to see a doctor?
items.why: The sentence already has 怎么, so only the softening 呢 may finish it. 吗 would add a second question marker.

items.py: wǒ jīn tiān shén me dōu bù xiǎng chī
items.en: I don't feel like eating anything today.
items.why: 什么 before 都 + 不 means 'nothing at all'. 吗 would turn it into a question, and 要 does not make 什么 mean 'anything'.

items.zh: 他病了，一天什么都没吃。
items.py: tā bìng le yī tiān shén me dōu méi chī
items.en: He was ill and ate nothing all day.
items.why: 什么 + 都 + 没 means 'nothing at all'. Without 都 the sentence would read as a question or be incomplete.

items.q: 这件事___都知道，你不用问了。
items.zh: 这件事谁都知道，你不用问了。
items.py: zhè jiàn shì shéi dōu zhī dào nǐ bù yòng wèn le
items.en: Everyone knows about this, so you needn't ask.
items.why: 谁 + 都 means 'everyone'. 哪 needs a measure word and 什么 would mean 'everything', not 'everyone'.

items.q: 医生说我身体很好，没___问题。
items.zh: 医生说我身体很好，没什么问题。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ shēn tǐ hěn hǎo méi shén me wèn tí
items.en: The doctor said I'm in good health, with nothing much wrong.
items.why: 没什么 + noun means 'no particular problem'. 哪儿 and 谁 cannot modify 问题 in this way.

items.q: 雪下得太大了，我们___也去不了。
items.zh: 雪下得太大了，我们哪儿也去不了。
items.py: xuě xià de tài dà le wǒ men nǎ r yě qù bù liǎo
items.en: The snow was so heavy that we couldn't go anywhere.
items.why: The cue is 'go anywhere', so 哪儿 + 也 + a negative. 什么 would mean 'nothing', and 谁 would mean 'nobody'.

items.q: 这个病的名字太难了，___都记不住。
items.zh: 这个病的名字太难了，谁都记不住。
items.py: zhè ge bìng de míng zi tài nán le shéi dōu jì bu zhù
items.en: The name of this illness is so hard that nobody can remember it.
items.why: 谁 before 都 and a negative means 'nobody'. 哪里 would mean 'nowhere', and 怎么 cannot take 都 in this way.

items.q: 你___说你感冒了吗？怎么还去游泳？
items.zh: 你不是说你感冒了吗？怎么还去游泳？
items.py: nǐ bù shì shuō nǐ gǎn mào le ma zěn me hái qù yóu yǒng
items.en: Didn't you say you had a cold? How come you're still going swimming?
items.why: 不是 … 吗 reminds the listener of what they said, with surprise at the contradiction. 是不是 would be a second question marker with 吗.

items.q: 昨天天气预报___说今天是晴天吗？怎么下雨了？
items.zh: 昨天天气预报不是说今天是晴天吗？怎么下雨了？
items.py: zuó tiān tiān qì yù bào bù shì shuō jīn tiān shì qíng tiān ma zěn me xià yǔ le
items.en: Didn't the forecast say yesterday that today would be sunny? How come it's raining?
items.why: The speaker remembers the forecast and is surprised by the rain, so 不是 follows the subject and 吗 closes the sentence. 是不是 together with 吗 would be a double question marker.

items.q: 你不是对海鲜过敏___？怎么还吃虾？
items.zh: 你不是对海鲜过敏吗？怎么还吃虾？
items.py: nǐ bù shì duì hǎi xiān guò mǐn ma zěn me hái chī xiā
items.en: Aren't you allergic to seafood? Why are you still eating shrimp?
items.why: The rhetorical frame 不是 … 吗 needs 吗 at the end. 呢 and 了 cannot close it.

items.q: 他不是上个月就出院___吗？
items.zh: 他不是上个月就出院了吗？
items.py: tā bù shì shàng ge yuè jiù chū yuàn le ma
items.en: Didn't he leave hospital last month already?
items.why: Between 不是 and 吗 the sentence keeps its own aspect, and 就 … 了 marks something already done. 过 and 着 do not fit the 'already' idea.

items.py: nǐ tóu téng bù téng
items.en: Does your head hurt?
items.why: The A-not-A form ends the sentence in place, with no 吗.

items.py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng qù kàn yī shēng
items.en: Do you want to go and see a doctor?
items.why: The modal 想 is doubled before the main verb 去.

items.py: nǐ men yě xǐ huan qiū tiān ma
items.en: Do you like autumn too?
items.why: After 也 the question is marked with 吗 at the end; A-not-A is not possible after 也.

items.py: nǐ shì gǎn mào hái shi fā shāo
items.en: Do you have a cold or a fever?
items.why: 还是 joins the two parallel options and 吗 is left out.

items.py: míng tiān shì qíng tiān hái shi yīn tiān
items.en: Is tomorrow going to be sunny or cloudy?
items.why: 还是 sits between the two parallel predicates and the question needs no 吗.

items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù yī yuàn
items.en: When are you going to the hospital?
items.why: 什么时候 is a time word and goes before the verb, not at the end.

items.py: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ ge jì jié
items.en: Which season do you like best?
items.why: 哪个 stays in the object slot, right before the noun it asks about.

items.py: nǐ yī tiān chī jǐ cì yào
items.en: How many times a day do you take medicine?
items.why: 几 comes with its measure word (几次) and the question word stays before the noun.

items.py: zhè bǎ sǎn yào duō shao qián
items.en: How much is this umbrella?
items.why: The price is asked with 多少钱 at the end.

items.zh: 你们那儿几月开始下雪？
items.py: nǐ men nà r jǐ yuè kāi shǐ xià xuě
items.en: In which month does it start snowing where you are?
items.why: 几月 is a time phrase before the verb, and it needs no extra 吗.

items.py: nǐ zěn me hái méi shuì jiào
items.en: How come you still haven't gone to sleep?
items.why: 怎么 comes before 还没 and shows surprise.

items.py: nǐ wèi shén me bù xiǎng qù yī yuàn
items.en: Why don't you want to go to the hospital?
items.why: 为什么 goes before the negated verb phrase, like any adverbial.

items.py: nǐ měi tiān shuì duō cháng shí jiān
items.en: How long do you sleep every day?
items.why: 多长时间 closes the question after the verb as the duration.

items.py: nǐ jiā lí gōng yuán yǒu duō yuǎn
items.en: How far is your home from the park?
items.why: 有 + 多远 gives the distance after the 离 phrase.

items.py: wǒ men zhōu mò qù pá shān hǎo ma
items.en: Shall we go hiking at the weekend?
items.why: The suggestion comes first and 好吗 is added at the end as a tag.

items.py: nǐ zài chī shén me yào ne
items.en: What medicine are you taking?
items.why: 呢 ends a question-word question softly, after the whole sentence.

items.zh: 你明天不用上班是不是？
items.py: nǐ míng tiān bù yòng shàng bān shì bù shì
items.en: You don't have to work tomorrow, do you?
items.why: 是不是 can close the sentence as a tag that checks a fact, or sit before the predicate; both orders ask the same thing, and 吗 is not added.

items.py: wǒ nǎ r yě bù xiǎng qù
items.en: I don't want to go anywhere.
items.why: 哪儿 comes before 也 and 不, so the object-like place is placed before the verb.

items.py: zhè ge bìng shéi yě zhì bù liǎo
items.en: Nobody can cure this illness.
items.why: 谁 + 也 means 'nobody' and stays before the negative verb.

items.py: nǐ bù shì shuō míng tiān xià yǔ ma
items.en: Didn't you say it would rain tomorrow?
items.why: 不是 follows the subject and 吗 closes the sentence.

items.py: tā bù shì yǐ jīng chū yuàn le ma
items.en: Hasn't he already left hospital?
items.why: The middle part keeps 已经 … 了, with 不是 at the start and 吗 at the end.

items.py: nǐ bù shì bù xǐ huan dōng tiān ma
items.en: Don't you dislike winter?
items.why: 不是 … 吗 wraps the speaker's belief, and the inner 不 stays in the middle.

items.src_py: nǐ xǐ huan dōng tiān
items.task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
items.py: nǐ xǐ huan dōng tiān ma
items.en: Do you like winter?
items.why: A statement becomes a yes/no question by adding 吗 at the end.

items.src_py: nǐ xiǎng qù yī yuàn
items.task: Make it an A-not-A question.
items.py: nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng qù yī yuàn
items.en: Do you want to go to the hospital?
items.why: The modal 想 is doubled as 想不想, and no 吗 follows.

items.src_py: nǐ tóu téng
items.task: Ask 'your head or your stomach?' with 还是.
items.py: nǐ tóu téng hái shi dù zi téng
items.en: Does your head hurt or your stomach?
items.why: 还是 joins the two options, and no 吗 is added.

items.src_py: tā měi tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn qǐ chuáng
items.task: Ask what time she gets up.
items.py: tā měi tiān zǎo shang jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng
items.en: What time does she get up every morning?
items.why: The time word 六点 is replaced by 几点 in the same slot.

items.src_py: jīn tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo
items.task: Ask 'How is the weather today?'
items.py: jīn tiān tiān qì zěn me yàng
items.en: How is the weather today?
items.why: 怎么样 replaces the description 很好 in the predicate slot.

items.src_py: tā jīn nián sān shí suì le
items.task: Ask how old he is, using 多.
items.py: tā jīn nián duō dà le
items.en: How old is he this year?
items.why: Age is asked with 多大 and the final 了.

items.src_py: wǒ men qù hǎi biān wán
items.task: Add a tag asking whether that is OK.
items.py: wǒ men qù hǎi biān wán hǎo ma
items.en: Let's go to the seaside to play, shall we?
items.why: A suggestion followed by 好吗 asks for agreement.

items.src_py: jīn tiān dà jiā dōu lái le
items.task: Say that nobody came today.
items.py: jīn tiān shéi yě méi lái
items.en: Nobody came today.
items.why: 谁 + 也 + 没 means 'nobody'.

items.src_py: nǐ shuō guo míng tiān xià xuě
items.task: Turn it into 'Didn't you say…?' with 不是…吗.
items.zh: 你不是说过明天下雪吗？
items.py: nǐ bù shì shuō guo míng tiān xià xuě ma
items.en: Didn't you say it would snow tomorrow?
items.why: 不是 follows the subject and 吗 closes it.

items.py: nǐ men yě yào dǎ zhēn ma
items.en: Are you getting an injection too?
items.why: After 也 the only possible question marker is 吗, so this is correct even though it has no A-not-A form.

items.py: nǐ shì bù shì bù shū fu
items.en: Are you feeling unwell?
items.why: 是不是 before the predicate checks a guess, even when the predicate already contains 不. This is correct.

items.py: tā shì fā shāo hái shi ké sou
items.en: Does he have a fever or a cough?
items.why: 还是 joins two options and no 吗 follows, so this is correct.

items.s: 我不知道今天会不会下雨。
items.zh: 我不知道今天会不会下雨。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào jīn tiān huì bú huì xià yǔ
items.en: I don't know whether it will rain today.
items.why: A-not-A can sit inside a statement to mean 'whether'. It is not a question here, so this is correct.

items.s: 这个冬天他哪儿都没去。
items.zh: 这个冬天他哪儿都没去。
items.py: zhè ge dōng tiān tā nǎ r dōu méi qù
items.en: He didn't go anywhere this winter.
items.why: 哪儿 + 都 + 没 means 'nowhere', with the place in front of 都. It is a statement, so no question marker is expected.

items.py: tā zuì jìn méi shén me wèi kǒu
items.en: He hasn't had much appetite lately.
items.why: 没什么 + noun means 'not much of', with the noun staying after the verb. It is a statement, not a question.

items.s: 你不是在吃药吗？怎么还喝酒？
items.zh: 你不是在吃药吗？怎么还喝酒？
items.py: nǐ bù shì zài chī yào ma zěn me hái hē jiǔ
items.en: Aren't you taking medicine? How come you're still drinking alcohol?
items.why: 不是 … 吗 reminds the listener of what they said, and 怎么还 adds the 'how come' surprise. Both are correct here.

items.py: tā zěn me hái méi lái ne
items.en: How come he still hasn't come?
items.why: 怎么 before 还没 means 'how come', and 呢 may end such a question. This is correct.

items.py: nǐ yī tiān yào hē jǐ bēi shuǐ
items.en: How many glasses of water do you have to drink a day?
items.why: 几 is followed by the measure word 杯, so this is correct.

items.py: xià tiān qù hǎi biān zěn me yàng
items.en: How about going to the seaside in summer?
items.why: 怎么样 at the end of a suggestion asks 'how about it?'. This is correct.

items.s_py: tā yǒu bù yǒu gǎn mào
items.py: tā yǒu méi yǒu gǎn mào
items.en: Does he have a cold?
items.why: 有 is negated only with 没, so the A-not-A form is 有没有.

items.s: 他今天去医院或者回家？
items.s_py: tā jīn tiān qù yī yuàn huò zhě huí jiā
items.zh: 他今天去医院还是回家？
items.py: tā jīn tiān qù yī yuàn hái shi huí jiā
items.en: Is he going to the hospital or going home today?
items.why: A question that asks which of two options uses 还是. 或者 is only for statements.

items.s_py: nǐ xiǎng chī yào hái shi dǎ zhēn ma
items.py: nǐ xiǎng chī yào hái shi dǎ zhēn
items.en: Do you want to take medicine or have an injection?
items.why: 还是 already makes this a choice question, so adding 吗 doubles the question marker. It must end after 打针.

items.s_py: zhè ge yī yuàn yǒu jǐ yī shēng
items.py: zhè ge yī yuàn yǒu duō shao yī shēng
items.en: How many doctors does this hospital have?
items.why: 几 needs a measure word right after it, which is missing here. 多少 can stand directly before the noun.

items.s_py: jīn tiān de tiān qì zěn me
items.py: jīn tiān de tiān qì zěn me yàng
items.en: How is the weather today?
items.why: 'What is it like' needs 怎么样. 怎么 alone needs a verb after it and cannot end a sentence.

items.s_py: cóng zhè r dào yī yuàn zěn me yuǎn
items.py: cóng zhè r dào yī yuàn yǒu duō yuǎn
items.en: How far is it from here to the hospital?
items.why: Distance is asked with 多远. 怎么 + adjective does not mean 'how far'.

items.s_py: wǒ men qù pá shān hǎo bù hǎo ma
items.py: wǒ men qù pá shān hǎo bù hǎo
items.en: Shall we go hiking?
items.why: 好不好 is already the tag question, so adding 吗 doubles the question marker.

items.s_py: nǐ xǐ huan nǎ jì jié
items.py: nǐ xǐ huan nǎ ge jì jié
items.en: Which season do you like?
items.why: 哪 must be followed by a measure word, here 个, before the noun.
